newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's ACCC drops Berrivale action.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's ACCC drops Berrivale action.

text.p: The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) had discontinued its action against beverage and food group Berrivale Orchards Ltd over the use of product descriptions, the company said on Friday.
Berrivale said it had agreed to undertakings regarding the use of the terms "squeezed daily" and "crushed daily" on the labelling of its Daily Juice Company juice and to corrective advertising.
Managing director Richard Brooks said Berrivale had cooperated with the ACCC in recognition of the company's position as Australia's leading juice processor.

"While the ACCC has had minimal consumer enquiry regarding the term 'squeezed daily', the juice industry has now come to a general consensus that the term should mean that juice is squeezed on the same day it is bottled," he said.

Brooks said the Daily Juice orange juice contained some reconstituted juice in winter to maintain the consistency of flavour, but although it was declared on the back label of the product, the ACCC felt it was not sufficiently prominent.
He said he hoped other juice processors would now fall into line with the generally agreed definition for "squeezed daily".
